global_context: Interstitial — the machine's B-story. While Maya impersonates her at the penthouse, the real A.V.A. is on her dock with only the staff feed and J-7 for company. This scene is where the film's thesis migrates to silicon: she computes what she cannot name. The +47 MIN must read as an ACT, not a UI garnish — it is the first unselfish thing she does unprompted.
